name: OverviewPeriodWindowV1
steps: resolve anchor_local_date from request or current date in America/Guayaquil
daily: current=[anchor 00:00,next calendar day 00:00); previous=preceding calendar day
weekly: find Monday containing anchor; current=[Monday 00:00,next Monday 00:00); previous=prior Monday-to-Monday
monthly: current=[first day 00:00,first day next month 00:00); previous=prior calendar month
perform calendar arithmetic in America/Guayaquil before converting each boundary to UTC
canonicalize period kind, anchor local date and four UTC boundaries with StrictVersionedJson; SHA-256 becomes window_fingerprint
rules: never infer period membership from display-formatted timestamps
half-open interval prevents double membership at exact boundaries
month comparison is prior calendar month, not a fixed-duration subtraction
